hints.title: Repeated Modulo Base Seven
hints.text: Converting an integer to base seven requires repeatedly extracting remainder modulo seven and dividing by seven.

hints.title: Negative Sign Preservation Invariant
hints.text: Processing the absolute magnitude of the number and prepending a negative sign if the initial value was negative handles signed numbers.

hints.title: Divisive Digit Assembly Procedure
hints.text: If num is zero, return string zero. Note whether num is negative and work with its absolute value. Repeatedly extract num modulo seven and divide num by seven. If negative, add minus sign. Reverse the accumulated digit characters and return as a string.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(log7 N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Failing to handle negative signs or zero produces missing negative indicators or empty return strings.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Base-7 conversion takes O(log7 N) arithmetic operations and O(1) auxiliary space beyond the output string.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle zero as a special case and properly apply negative signs.
